_note: Source copy for the MONTE WO application shell (Step 1). Everything marked demo or notConnected is placeholder UI state. No athlete data, nutrition values, official ranks or integrations exist here.
title: Dashboard | MONTE WO
description: MONTE WO app shell: four independent discipline cards, a muscle character view and a demo food scan and macro logger. No athlete data, official ranks or integrations are connected yet.

account.label: Athlete
account.note: Accounts are not connected in this foundation.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Nothing is connected yet — every panel shows its real state.
dashboard.disciplinesNote: No rank transfers between disciplines and no overall rank is calculated. A card can only show an earned rank after approved standards exist and a qualifying performance is recorded.
dashboard.noRankText: Standards draft; athlete data not connected.

muscle.title: Where the work shows.
muscle.intro: Hover over or select a region to see its name and status. Regions map to the launch disciplines and the existing exercise guides.
muscle.figureLabel: Anatomical silhouette with four selectable regions: chest, core, arms and legs.
muscle.detailIdleText: Each region will show its linked discipline records once athlete data is connected. Nothing is connected in this foundation.
muscle.statusText: No athlete data is linked to this region. Its badge stays NOT CONNECTED until performances and approved standards exist.

regions.name: Chest
regions.text: Pressing strength. The Bench Press discipline is judged under its own MONTE Standard.

regions.name: Core
regions.text: Bracing and trunk control support every launch discipline, but no rank is awarded for the core itself.

regions.name: Arms
regions.text: Elbow flexion strength. The Strict Biceps Curl discipline has its own draft standard.

regions.name: Legs
regions.text: Squat and hinge strength. Squat and Deadlift are ranked independently of each other.

food.title: Fuel the climb.
food.intro: A demo of the planned logger. Searching and quick filters work with four demo items only; nutrition values are not available because no food database is connected.
food.searchHelp: Demo search over four sample items. No food database, API or saved history is connected.
food.scanHelp: Opens a viewfinder mockup. No camera permission is requested and nothing is captured.
food.emptyResults: Type a food name or choose a quick filter to see a demo item.
food.noMatch: No demo match. A real food database is not connected yet.
food.logEmpty: Nothing logged. Entries stay in this page only and are not saved.
food.macroNote: Protein, carbohydrate and fat totals need a connected nutrition source. Totals stay empty rather than showing invented numbers.

camera.title: Food scanning is not connected.
camera.frameLabel: Viewfinder mockup — no live camera feed
camera.text: This mockup shows where the camera view will appear. It does not request camera permission, capture images or recognize food. The website’s security headers currently disable camera access for all pages.

profile.title: Athlete profile
profile.text: Accounts, bodyweight and athlete categories are part of the MVP plan. There is no public account system yet, so nothing can be saved or displayed here.

performance.title: Performance records
performance.text: Discipline-specific entries with load, unit, repetitions, date, equipment and testing conditions are planned. Tested maximums will stay separate from estimated one-rep maximums.
planned: Tested single vs. estimated 1RM, clearly labelled

links.label: Estimate a 1RM in the free Strength Lab

standards.title: Four draft protocols
standards.text: Every discipline has a written MONTE Standard: the variation, equipment and validity checks a performance must meet. All four are draft and not approved, so they cannot award ranks.

rankings.title: Nine ranks per discipline
rankings.text: Each discipline climbs the same nine rank identities independently. No threshold tables are approved, so no athlete holds any of these ranks yet and no progress percentage can be shown.

library.title: Written guides by muscle group
library.text: The existing library has seven groups and written guides. Demonstrations and in-app exercise tracking are planned, not connected.

nutrition.title: Food search, Haitian options and macro tracking
nutrition.text: The Food Scan & Macro Logger on the Dashboard is a demo. Food search, camera scanning and protein, carbohydrate and fat tracking need a real nutrition source that has not been selected or approved.
planned: Food search with a licensed nutrition database
Haitian foods, including Griot and Diri ak Djon Djon

verification.title: Provisional and MONTE Verified
verification.text: Self-reported performances are Provisional. MONTE Verified requires evidence reviewed and approved by an authorized reviewer. Verification never raises a rank by itself, athletes cannot approve their own evidence, and reviewer decisions are kept as an audit history.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.text: Units, language and privacy controls will live here once accounts exist. This foundation stores nothing: no cookies, local storage or server records are created by the dashboard.

links.label: Delete account or clear this device

availableLabel: Works today on the public site
